subject: bootstrap: use versioned upgrade function (#61830)
summary: Session bootstrap/upgrade refactor: upgrade steps moved into `pkg/session/upgrade.go` and dispatched via an explicit ordered `versionedUpgradeFunction` table; `upgrade()` now runs only versions greater than the stored bootstrap version. Verified the version/function mapping is strictly increasing, name-matched, and order-equivalent to the previous `bootstrapVersion` list; no Blocker/High correctness, upgrade-semantic, or session/transaction behavior issues found. Checked follow-up history up to `upstream/master`; no later change indicates a regression fix specific to this refactor.
